## 更新内容
- 修复删除后撤销导致文字重复
- 修复中文键盘打开时 Shift 保持锁定
- 修复方案列表无法编辑和删除
- 修复设置弹窗在浅色背景下文字看不清
- 调整设置页和键盘面板的界面样式
- 调整按键处理，减少输入响应延迟
- 新增可选的输入耗时诊断

## Changes
- Fixed duplicated text when undoing a deletion
- Fixed Shift staying locked when the Chinese keyboard opens
- Fixed schema list entries that could not be edited or deleted
- Fixed unreadable text in settings dialogs on a light background
- Changed the look of the settings pages and keyboard panels
- Changed key handling to reduce input response latency
- Added optional input latency diagnostics
